units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 31b:11">Kidd. 31ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>זִכְרוֹנוֹ לברכה</he> (abbr. <he>ז״ל</he>) of blessed memory, v. <cite ref="G00467"><he>זָכַר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:5:3">Y. Shek. II, 47ᵃ</cite> top <he>דבריהן הן זִכְרוֹנָן</he> their words are their monument; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82:10">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> <he>זִכְרוֹנֵיהֶם</he> (pl.).
R. Hash. 27ᵃ ז׳ ליום ראשון typical of the first day of creation; a. fr.—Esp. a Biblical verse in which Divine remembrance is alluded to, citation of verses &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 4:6">R. Hash. IV, 6</cite> <he>ז׳ … של פורענות</he> citation of remembrance … for evil.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 32b:15">Ib. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ של יחיד</he> a verse treating of the remembrance by the Lord of an individual; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זִכְרוֹנוֹת</he>.
Ber. 6ᵃ ספר הז׳ the Divine records; a. fr.—Esp. Zikhronoth, that portion of the Musaf of the New Year’s Day which treats of Divine remembrance.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 4:5">R. Hash. IV, 5</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—Constr. <he>זִכְרוֹנֵי</he>, v. supra.
